description:
WOZ-value lookup (WOZ-waarde)

Returns the Dutch government property assessment value (WOZ-waarde) for a property,
including the historical values of the last three years. Alongside the value, the
ground area of the WOZ object (grondoppervlakte) and the linked cadastral parcel
(kadastrale gemeente code, sectie and perceelnummer) are returned.
The endpoint accepts either a BAG nummeraanduiding identificatie directly, or a
Dutch address (postcode + house number, optionally with a house letter or number
addition).

When an address is supplied, the BAG (PDOK Locatieserver) is queried first to resolve
the nummeraanduiding identifier, after which the public sources are queried.
When a nummeraanduiding ID is supplied directly, we try to fetch the WOZ value from the public sources.

## Address notation

Split a Dutch address into the separate BAG fields. Never put the house letter or the
addition in `house_number`, and do not combine them into a single field:

- `house_number`: the numeric part only, e.g. `161`
- `house_letter`: a single letter, e.g. `C`
- `house_number_addition`: the addition without a hyphen and with leading zeros preserved, e.g. `03` (not `3`, `C-03` or `C03`)

Example: `Hooidrift 161C-03, 3023KN Rotterdam` →
`?postcode=3023KN&house_number=161&house_letter=C&house_number_addition=03`.

When the exact `house_number_addition` is unknown but the main address exists,
the endpoint falls back to that address and returns HTTP 200 with
`matched_on: "without_addition"` and `available_house_number_additions`.
This fallback is free (0 credits).

Results are cached for 30 days.

For some requests we use upstream servers with a default timeout of 8 seconds.

Source: Public sources

Cost: 10 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.

house_letter.description: Single house letter (e.g. C). Do not include the addition here.

house_number_addition.description: Addition without a hyphen, preserving leading zeros (e.g. 03, not 3 or C-03).

id.description: BAG nummeraanduiding identificatie (16 digits). Alternative to postcode + house_number.

postcode.description: Dutch postcode, with or without a space (e.g. 3023KN).

name: property.woz.waarde
